title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：technique　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 technique 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the engineer ① learnt the technique that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the learning was the whole of the year. The ② technique, meaning the method itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a technique, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ technique in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ technique at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A technique, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the technique was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the method. The ⑥ technique, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; technique, he said, is either something you learn or the only word that means both a method and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ technique had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ technique of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; technique, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ technique I remember is the method counted in the manual, which closed in 1983 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ technique, my mother said in 1985, is the only method that improves by being counted; every technique, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a method. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 技巧；手法（指车间里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 技巧；手法（指那种技巧本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：learn the technique 学这一种技巧
D. n. 技巧；手法（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 技巧之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的技巧之事）
F. n. 技巧；手法（指说明书里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 技巧、功夫（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 功夫（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: learn the technique 意为“学这一种技巧”，1976 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯清点的一种技巧做了一遍。
technique 意为“技巧；手法”，指那种技巧本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
technique 意为“技巧；手法”，指车间里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
technique 意为“技巧；手法”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
technique 意为“技巧、功夫”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种功夫就是那件事的全部。
technique 意为“功夫”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种技巧，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
technique 意为“技巧；手法”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1981 年这一种成了说明书里的一行。
technique 意为“技巧之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的技巧之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
technique 意为“技巧；手法”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一种，1983 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一种。
technique 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，技巧是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的技巧。
